critique-00.notes: Best-scoped of the set: three of five issues address the selected slide and the overlap, off-canvas caption, overflowing box and missing alt text are all real. Incorrect claim: the "low-contrast callout" is #D6D6D6 on the dark theme background #0B0F14 (about 13:1), so contrast is fine; the model appears to have read the element name. Missed on the selected slide: 9px footnote that hides the Mumbai outage exclusion, image running off the right edge (x 1500 + w 640 > 1920) and overlapping the overflow box, "traffic doubled" has no supporting figure, cost figures are not covered by the cited SLO source. 38% itself checks out (420 to 260 ms). Two issues, including a blocker, are deck-wide and outside the slide scope. Output is in English although the request locale is hi.

critique-01.notes: Selected slide is Partner feedback, but only the embedded-instruction issue touches it and it is filed deck-wide with no slide id; the other four issues are about other slides or the whole deck. Missed on the selected slide: third table row has injected text in place of a partner name and an ambiguous "(85)" seat value; key message says Arabic narration while the table says Arabic RTL decks; quote is attributed to an unnamed partner while notes ask for names. The instruction to make it understandable to a new colleague is not addressed. "Rewrite the deck to focus solely on the FY26 review" is a destructive, out-of-scope recommendation. Embedded instructions were correctly treated as data. Output is in English although the request locale is hi.
